segments.name: banking
products: checking, savings, time and money market accounts
segments.description: Commercial and retail banking across southeastern Ohio and western West Virginia, offering deposits, loans and trust services.
segments.evidence: Ohio Valley's financial service operations are considered by management to be aggregated in one reportable segment: banking.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest and fees on loans, which account for most of total revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: Consolidated interest and fee revenue from loans accounted for 77.84% and 73.02% of total consolidated revenues in 2025 and 2024, respectively.
